response.overview: 29 minutes of train-writing graffiti action from Warsaw, Poland. Produced by Street Life Concept, the film follows writers Kuick [TNA] and Merd [NS/HXM] with guest appearances by Polish and foreign writers - rolling trains, live painting missions, daytime and nighttime bombing. Soundtrack by Warsaw rap producers 600V, Steez83, Szczur JWP, Siwers and NWS, mixed and scratched by DJ Vazee and DJ Falcon 1. Premiered 27 September 2024 in Warsaw, screened in Polish cinemas, and distributed on USB flash media together with a 128-page album.
response.title: Writers With Attitude
